lines: Somewhere, there's a library... with a book for every life you didn't live.
Every time you choose, the world splits in two. And a new book appears.
The life where you said yes.
The one where you took the other road.
The one where you never met them.
People come here looking for a happier ending. But here's the secret.
In every single book... the other you is reading about you. Wishing they were you.
Oh. Look. A new book. Just now.
The life where you scrolled past this video.
